description.value: Breakfast Table is a family-run brunch spot on South Granville founded in 2016 by brothers-in-law George Koay and Michael Lee, blending Asian flavour influences with classic comfort-food brunch dishes. Popular items include Breakfast Ratatouille, Challah French Toast, and an Ube Latte. The restaurant operates on a walk-in-only basis with a street-front patio at the Granville location.
